# Label Taxonomy Proposal

Use a predictable label matrix so contributors can route work quickly.

## Type labels

- `type:bug`
- `type:feature`
- `type:docs`
- `type:refactor`
- `type:test`
- `type:adoption`

## Area labels

- `area:core`
- `area:agent`
- `area:gateway`
- `area:workflow`
- `area:memory`
- `area:skills`
- `area:mcp`
- `area:sandbox`
- `area:federation`
- `area:channels`
- `area:cli`
- `area:docs`

## Maturity / stage labels

- `stage:now` (already-shipped surfaces)
- `stage:next` (active roadmap expansion)
- `stage:federation` (cross-host evolution)

## Priority labels

- `priority:p0`
- `priority:p1`
- `priority:p2`

## State labels

- `need:triage`
- `need:repro`
- `need:design`
- `status:blocked`
- `status:in-progress`
- `status:ready`
